    - **hmans/beans remains dormant upstream** — zero commits since 2026-04-06 (99260bf) and no release since v0.4.2 (2026-03-10), with 39 open and 21 closed issues. No storage or corruption defect has surfaced in our usage, and scripts/beans-fallback.ts covers environments without the Go binary. - **gastownhall/beads continues high-velocity development (592 commits since 2026-09-23, v1.3.1 on 2026-09-30, v1.3.2 on 2026-10-24) with no new go.mod retractions**, and closed earlier migration-gate issues (#6547, #6575). However, v1.3.1 introduced a concurrent-write reversion bug in its blocked-state recheck (#7030) and two data-loss bugs in retention and auto-backup (#7031, #7032) that required v1.3.2 to fix; migration 0059 (v1.3.0) over-set stored is_blocked flags on embedded Dolt 2.2.0 (#7037, requiring a manual bd recompute-blocked per workspace); #4356 (dirty working set blocking bd dolt pull without manual DOLT_ADD -f) remains open; and new multi-clone migration, bd dolt pull and bd sync conflict/data-loss issues continue to open (#6727 unmergeable stores after migration 0062, #7039 empty events history on pull-adopting clones, #7073 fresh-clone pull wedge, #7294 bd compact re-dating commits so tracker pulls overwrite unpushed edits, #7757 bd sync dropping a clone's comment on concurrent edits, #7783 bd sync silently reopening a closed bead on status conflict, #7811 bd dolt pull --strategy ours reverting remote labels, and #7781/#7795 GitHub/GitLab pulls overwriting beads by issue number across projects). - **Question for the owner (b91x / q2aj):** given that beans is dormant-but-stable on plain Markdown files while Beads (v1.3.2) is still working through multi-clone Dolt sync, merge and migration edge cases, should we **(a) keep beans** (and either close the watch or recheck again after 2026-12-23 as originally scheduled in b91x), **(b) trial Beads alongside beans** in a single isolated workspace, **(c) fork/maintain beans** (or lean on our in-tree TypeScript tooling), or **(d) plan a migration to Beads**?
